# Madwackd Productions

> Madwackd Productions is an AI-powered film and video production studio headquartered in Denver, Colorado, founded by producer Zach Wennstedt. It makes comedy shorts, animated cartoons for kids and adults, parody, ads and brand films, music videos, documentaries and feature films. Its first feature, EARTH, is in production for Summer 2027.

## Key facts
- Name: Madwackd Productions (also written Madwackd)
- Website: https://www.madwackd.com/
- Headquarters: Denver, Colorado, USA. Produces for audiences and clients everywhere.
- Founder and producer: Zach Wennstedt, a Denver entrepreneur, marketer since 2012 and sales leader
- What it makes: comedy shorts, AI animated shorts and cartoons, parody, AI commercial production, brand films, music videos, documentaries, feature films
- How it works: AI tools create characters, voices and imagery; people write, direct, edit and approve every project
- Contact: the inquiry form at https://www.madwackd.com/work-with-us/ (partnerships, investing, acting or voice talent, collaborations, hired production, press)

## Our work (made in-house)
- Tell Me Why: country music video, 4:19, written and produced by Zach Wennstedt
- What Love Really Is: neon cartoon music video, 5:01, written and produced by Zach Wennstedt
- TV commercials: Make the Phone Ring (Eye To Ad Media, 0:30), Stay Home (Aging Safely Baths, 0:30), Where Did They Go? (Search Converts, 0:26)
- Watch them at https://www.madwackd.com/#work

## Sister site
- madwackd.ai (https://www.madwackd.ai/) is the Madwackd AI video studio, where businesses and creators make videos

## EARTH (feature film, in production)
- Logline: in a backwards world addicted to its feeds, where money is the only score that counts, one guy wakes up and learns that love and kindness matter more than money
- Genre: family-friendly satire comedy, no cussing
- Status: in production; no trailer released yet
- Planned release: Summer 2027 at watchvrmovie.com ("coming to a theater NOT near you")
- Waitlist and sneak peeks: https://www.theearthmovie.com/
- AI disclosure: EARTH uses AI-generated characters, voices and imagery. Any resemblance to real persons is coincidental.

## Policies
- Madwackd does not accept unsolicited scripts, treatments or story ideas; only links to public reels or portfolios
- Nothing on the site is an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any security
- Roles, partnerships and projects happen only by written agreement
